arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import time, re
log='/tmp/flutter_run.log'
start=time.time()
pat=re.compile(r'Dart VM Service on.* is available at: (http://[^\s]+)')
while time.time()-start<120:
    try:
        txt=open(log,'r',encoding='utf-8',errors='ignore').read()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        time.sleep(0.5); continue
    m=pat.search(txt)
    if m:
        print('FOUND',m.group(1))
        break
    time.sleep(0.5)
else:
    print('NOT FOUND')
    print(txt[-2000:])
PY
